biographical_milestones.event: Awarded Nobel Prize in Physics for Radiation Discovery
biographical_milestones.historical_context: First woman to win a Nobel Prize alongside Pierre Curie.

biographical_milestones.event: Sudden Tragic Demise of Husband Pierre Curie
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Husband killed in street accident in Paris.

biographical_milestones.event: Awarded Second Nobel Prize in Chemistry (Radium & Polonium)
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Became first person to win two Nobel Prizes in different sciences.

biographical_milestones.event: Demise from Aplastic Anemia due to Radiation Exposure
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Passed away in Passy sanatorium from career radiation poisoning.
